title: A world model for longitudinal health-trajectory prediction in older adults across multinational cohorts
abstract: arXiv:2611.28175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aging is characterized by continuously evolving health states, yet most existing prediction models focus on static health risk at isolated time points rather than explicitly modelling how health trajectories unfold over time. We developed a health world model based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to represent evolving health states and simulate future trajectories under specified actions. The model combines a state encoder, an action- and context-conditioned predictor, a stop-gradient target encoder, and clinical outcome heads. We trained the model on the US Health and Retirement Study (HRS) and evaluated it without refitting in the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA) and the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS). translated_title: 一种用于跨国队列中老年人纵向健康轨迹预测的世界模型
translated_abstract: 衰老以持续演变的健康状态为特征，然而大多数现有的预测模型关注的是孤立时间点上的静态健康风险，而非显式地建模健康轨迹如何随时间展开。我们基于联合嵌入预测架构开发了一个健康世界模型，用于表示不断演变的健康状态，并在指定动作条件下模拟未来轨迹。该模型结合了状态编码器、动作与上下文条件化的预测器、停止梯度目标编码器以及临床结局预测头。我们在美国健康与退休研究（HRS）上训练了该模型，并在英国老年纵向研究（ELSA）和中国健康与养老追踪调查（CHARLS）中无需重新拟合即直接评估。开环评估考察了模型对死亡率以及日常生活活动能力（ADL）和工具性日常生活活动能力（IADL）恶化的区分度与校准度。
tldr: 该研究提出了首个基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的健康世界模型，能够显式建模老年人健康状态的演变并模拟未来健康轨迹，且在美国HRS数据上训练后无需重新拟合即可跨国泛化到英国ELSA和中国CHARLS队列，预测死亡率及ADL/IADL恶化。
en_tdlr: The study introduces a JEPA-based health world model that explicitly represents evolving health states and simulates future health trajectories of older adults, trained on the US HRS cohort and generalizing without refitting to multinational cohorts (ELSA and CHARLS) to predict mortality and ADL/IADL worsening.
